Bold comic-book ink style, heavy linework, red and blue-black palette, night city. 

Use <Picture 2> and <Picture 1> as reference frames and <Audio 1> exactly as it is.

CUT 1: top-down view of the little boy superhero on the rooftop — red cape fluttering in the wind, hands planted on his hips, freckles and a cocky grin as he looks straight up into the camera. The camera slowly descends toward him as he delivers his line — as he speaks, comic-book graphic overlay text word by word in sync with his voice: "GET READY TO" - "MEET" — "YOUR" — "MAKER" — huge jagged comic lettering, white with heavy black outlines and red drop shadows, tilted at scrappy angles, until the three words hang stacked in the air above him between his face and the lens.
TRANSITION: a violent WHIP PAN off the rooftop that SMEARS the floating words away with it, motion-streaked —


CUT 2: low hero angle on the colossal black mech-kaiju towering over the skyline as it rears back and unleashes a GIANT terrifying ROAR — jaws wide with fangs, red eyes and chest-core flaring blinding bright, blue lightning arcing off its head, the roar's shockwave rippling dust and rattling windows down the buildings, comic-style speed-lines and ink splatter bursting from the impact of the sound. It leans INTO the camera as the roar peaks. Hold on the roar.

nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

PERFORMANCE REFERENCE

GPU:V100-SXM2-32G+96G RAM


LORA=REF2V TURBO 4STEPS LORA APPLIED W/ NUMBER = STRENGTH

FP16=ENABLE FP16 ACCUMULATION

X=STEPS

CFLVA=CHUNK FEEDBACK & LOW VRAM ATTENTION APPLIED

Quality Marks Below 5 = NOT GOOD

Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
REFERENCE ASSIGNMENTS:

Reference image 1 is the exact final frame of the previous clip.
It defines the exact starting frame, the same realistic rock pigeon,
the same red Tesla, cloud road, palace, sky, lighting,
vehicle direction and exterior camera perspective.

Reference image 2 defines the exact target Tesla interior,
the final rear-center camera position, cabin architecture,
girl, capybara, seats, center console, black touchscreen
and windshield composition.

Reference image 2 is the exact desired final frame.

CONTINUITY:

Continue directly from reference image 1.
The first frame must match reference image 1 exactly.

Preserve the same rock pigeon, red Tesla, cloud road,
palace, clouds, lighting and direction of travel.

The Tesla drives forward at one constant continuous speed
from the first frame to the final frame.

It never stops, brakes, freezes, slows down, reverses,
changes direction or leaves the cloud road.

REAR HATCH DEFINITION:

Use only the Tesla's rear hatchback liftgate at the back of the vehicle.

This is the large rear cargo hatch directly facing the camera.
It is not the front hood or front trunk.
It is not a side door or side window.

The rear liftgate opens upward on its normal roof hinges,
revealing one centered rear cargo opening.

The liftgate remains attached to the Tesla.
It must not detach, split, bend, duplicate or transform.

All side doors and side windows remain completely closed.

PIGEON:

Preserve the same realistic common rock pigeon from reference image 1.

It has a gray head, iridescent green-and-purple neck,
light gray body, dark wing bars, darker tail,
red-orange eyes and physically correct proportions.

There is exactly one pigeon.

The pigeon flies at normal real-time speed,
using several natural wingbeats followed by short controlled glides.

During its approach to the moving Tesla,
it matches the vehicle's speed,
uses rapid compact braking wingbeats,
fans its tail and aligns with the center of the rear cargo opening.

No slow motion, hovering, floating, frozen wings,
extra wings, anatomy errors or size changes.

TIMELINE:

0.0–0.3 seconds:

Begin from the exact composition of reference image 1.

The red Tesla continues driving forward at constant speed.
The camera follows behind and slightly above the same pigeon.

The cloud road continues moving beneath the vehicle.

0.3–1.3 seconds:

The pigeon flies directly toward the center rear of the Tesla.

It gradually descends and matches the vehicle's forward speed.

At the same time, the Tesla's rear hatchback liftgate
smoothly opens upward while the vehicle continues driving.

Only the rear liftgate opens.
All doors and side windows remain closed.

The Tesla must not slow down or stop while the hatch opens.

1.3–2.1 seconds:

The rear hatch is now fully open,
revealing a clear centered cargo entrance.

The pigeon aligns precisely with the center of the rear opening.

It uses rapid braking wingbeats,
narrows its wings slightly
and flies cleanly into the rear cargo compartment.

The pigeon must not collide with the liftgate,
rear bumper, taillights, roof or cargo-opening edges.

The camera follows smoothly behind the pigeon
toward the center of the rear opening.

2.1–2.5 seconds:

As the pigeon passes through the rear hatch,
its moving gray wings briefly fill the entire camera frame.

Use this complete feather occlusion as a hidden transition
from the exterior rear-hatch view to the interior cabin view.

During the fully covered frames,
switch directly to the exact Tesla interior shown in reference image 2.

Do not visibly transform the rear hatch into seats.
Do not blend the exterior vehicle body with the cabin.
Do not show the camera colliding with the hatch or rear seats.

2.5–3.0 seconds:

The feather occlusion clears and reveals
the exact rear-center Tesla interior from reference image 2.

The camera is now positioned at the rear-center cabin viewpoint,
facing forward between the front seats.

The pigeon has already entered the rear cargo area
and remains behind or below the camera,
outside the visible frame.

Do not generate any visible pigeon inside the final cabin composition.

After the pigeon enters, the rear liftgate closes automatically
behind the camera and remains off-screen.

The Tesla continues driving forward without interruption.

3.0–5.0 seconds:

Hold the exact interior composition from reference image 2.

The camera is rigidly mounted relative to the Tesla cabin,
but the vehicle continues moving forward at constant speed.

The girl remains in the left front driver seat.
She preserves the exact face, hairstyle and costume
shown in reference image 2.

She keeps both hands naturally near or on the steering wheel,
looks forward at the road and continues driving.

She does not turn around, speak or look at the camera.

The capybara remains upright in the right front passenger seat.

Preserve its brown fur, body proportions
and orange safety helmet.

It looks forward calmly.
It does not speak, drive, transform
or exchange seats with the girl.

The central touchscreen remains black,
flat, rectangular, centered and unchanged.

Through the windshield, the cloud road,
clouds and distant palace continuously move backward
with natural parallax.

This continuous exterior motion clearly proves
that the Tesla is still driving forward.

FINAL FRAME:

The final frame must match reference image 2 exactly.

Preserve the same rear-center camera position,
field of view, perspective, girl position,
capybara position, seats, headrests,
center console, black touchscreen
and windshield composition.

The camera becomes stationary relative to the cabin
before the final frame.

The Tesla itself continues moving forward.

No pigeon is visible in the final frame.

CAMERA:

Use one continuous forward-following camera movement.

First follow the pigeon behind the moving Tesla.
Then approach the centered open rear hatch.

Use the complete feather occlusion
to hide the transition into the cabin.

After the transition, settle smoothly
into the rear-center interior viewpoint.

No side-window entry.
No random pan, orbit, shake,
violent acceleration, sudden zoom,
camera inversion or perspective collapse.

VEHICLE CONSISTENCY:

Preserve one physically consistent red Tesla.

The exterior and interior belong to the same vehicle.

The Tesla maintains constant forward velocity
during the entire clip.

The wheels and cloud-road motion continue naturally.

Do not stop the car when the hatch opens.
Do not stop the car when the pigeon enters.
Do not stop the car during the transition.

Preserve the rear hatch, roof, body,
taillights, seats, steering wheel,
center console, touchscreen and windows.

No duplicated hatch, seats, steering wheels,
touchscreens, doors, characters or pigeons.

AUDIO:

No human speech, dialogue, narration,
whispering or singing.

Use continuous high-altitude wind,
Tesla road and electric-motor ambience,
natural pigeon wingbeats,
a subtle powered rear-liftgate opening sound,
then a brief closing sound behind the camera.

The road and motor sounds continue uninterrupted,
proving that the Tesla never stops.

No background music, subtitles,
text overlays, watermark or additional voices.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS:

No front trunk opening.
No front hood opening.
No side-door opening.
No side-window entry.
No vehicle stopping.
No braking or freezing.
No detached or deformed rear hatch.
No pigeon collision.
No visible pigeon in the final frame.
No giant pigeon inside the cabin.
No pigeon fused with seats or characters.
No driver and passenger swapping positions.
No duplicated girl or capybara.
No cabin deformation.
No exterior/interior texture fusion.
No random camera movement.
